title: Introduction to LibrePCB A new, powerful and intuitive EDA tool for everyone
summary: Urban Bruhin, LibrePCB's main author, introduces the open-source EDA tool at FOSDEM 2018. He explains why he started it and how its library concepts differ from KiCAD.
why: Linked by the author and others in LibrePCB threads as the best explanation of its design rationale.

quote.text: Here's a video from FOSDEM where Urban (the main author) explains why he started LibrePCB
